high_level_description: This image depicts a naval fleet of ships sailing on the open ocean. The scene is set during the day under clear skies, with the vast expanse of deep blue water stretching out to the horizon. The ships are moving at a steady pace, leaving white trails of wake behind them, indicating their speed. The fleet consists of several large vessels, including aircraft carriers, which are identifiable by their flat decks and the presence of numerous aircraft parked or taking off from them.
